opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who will coordinate the visit; some specialist arts institutions may also apply. The host institution must administer the grant. Visitors must be eminent senior professors from overseas.
opportunities.summary: To enable UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research. Priority given to new or recent collaborations.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education in the UK, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible for UKRI funding. Principal Investigator must be employed by an eligible institution or have maintained close links following retirement.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project (up to 5 years). Assessed via a two-stage process. The outline stage is paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; the detailed application deadline is 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research, policy-influencing research, immediate commercial application, database assembly, advocacy, capacity building, networking or skills development

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration, are resident in the UK at application, and are permanent members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline, particularly those prevented by routine duties, to complete a programme of original research. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on this page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, who live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year and hold/have held a post at a UK university or eligible independent research organisation, with an established research record.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career scholars at UK universities with research degree awarding powers, with at least two years' research/teaching experience post-PhD, holding or nominated for a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent, and at an early stage of career (not yet led a research team).
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Awards up to £1 million over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: Any research area except medical/clinical research, policy-driven research, advocacy, immediate commercial application, and database assembly

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered with the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers. Each university may submit one application as principal applicant but may partner in multiple proposals.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Up to £10 million over up to 10 years. The Leverhulme Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: Blue-skies, transformative, multidisciplinary research; any topic in Trust remit except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate by the time they take up the Fellowship, and must hold a UK degree or UK academic position. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers, with a research record but not yet holding a full-time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work. Fellowships tenable for 3 years, with joint salary support from the Trust and host university, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses. Closing date 18 February 2027.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications
